summary: Keep product-facing work useful to its real audience while preventing scope creep and private-context leakage.

scenarios.title: Trim a technical product screen
scenarios.prompt: Use $audience-scope-discipline to review this settings screen. Keep only information customers need to decide or act.
scenarios.outcome: An audience-based content decision that moves operational and diagnostic detail out of the default view.

scenarios.title: Guard a narrow implementation
scenarios.prompt: Apply $audience-scope-discipline while implementing this request. Do not absorb adjacent cleanup or local setup into the product.
scenarios.outcome: The smallest coherent change, with material risks challenged once and unrelated improvements left separate.
